# testing_oas_servers_path (Resource)

OASServersPath Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_oas_servers_path" "my_oasserverspath" {
  local_string = "...my_local_string..."
  server_url   = "http://example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `local_string` (String)
- `server_url` (String) Path-defined server URL

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_oas_servers_path.my_testing_oas_servers_path
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_oas_servers_path.my_testing_oas_servers_path "..."
```
